---
title: "Publications"
---

<br>

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
'%||%' <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a
suppressWarnings(suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(yaml)))
pubs <- read_yaml("content/publications.yml")
pubs <- Filter(function(x) identical(x$type, "publication"), pubs)
main_pubs <- Filter(function(x) x$refereed %||% TRUE, pubs)
other_pubs <- Filter(function(x) identical(x$refereed, FALSE), pubs)

html_escape <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x
}

render_pub_entry <- function(p, num) {
  if (nzchar(p$title_url %||% "")) {
    title_html <- sprintf('<span class="pub-title"><a href="%s">%s</a></span>',
      p$title_url, html_escape(p$title))
  } else {
    title_html <- sprintf('<span class="pub-title">%s</span>', html_escape(p$title))
  }
  cat(sprintf("\n%s. %s  \n", num, title_html))
  auths <- p$authors %||% list()
  if (length(auths) > 0) {
    parts <- vapply(auths, function(a) {
      if (nzchar(a$url %||% "")) {
        sprintf('[%s](%s)', html_escape(a$name), a$url)
      } else {
        html_escape(a$name)
      }
    }, character(1))
    cat(sprintf("   (*with %s*)  \n", paste(parts, collapse = ", ")))
  }
  if (!is.null(p$venue) && nzchar(p$venue)) {
    cat(sprintf("   *%s*  \n", html_escape(p$venue)))
  }
  if (nzchar(p$notes %||% "")) {
    cat(sprintf("   *%s*  \n", html_escape(p$notes)))
  }
  for (lnk in p$links %||% list()) {
    text <- lnk$label
    if (nzchar(lnk$suffix %||% "")) text <- paste0(text, lnk$suffix)
    cat(sprintf("   [[%s](%s)]\n", text, lnk$url))
  }
  ab <- trimws(p$abstract %||% "")
  if (nzchar(ab)) {
    ab <- html_escape(ab)
    inner <- ""
    kf <- p$key_figure
    if (!is.null(kf) && nzchar(kf$path %||% "")) {
      cap <- trimws(kf$caption %||% "")
      inner <- sprintf('<figure class="key-figure"><img src="%s" alt="Key result">', kf$path)
      if (nzchar(cap)) inner <- paste0(inner, sprintf('<figcaption class="key-figure-caption">%s</figcaption>', html_escape(cap)))
      inner <- paste0(inner, "</figure>\n ")
    }
    inner <- paste0(inner, ab)
    cat(sprintf("   <details class=\"abstract\">\n  <summary>Summary</summary>\n %s\n</details>\n\n", inner))
  }
}

cat("\n")
for (i in seq_along(main_pubs)) {
  render_pub_entry(main_pubs[[i]], i)
}
cat('\n<div class="pub-section-gap" aria-hidden="true"></div>\n\n## Other Publications\n\n')
for (i in seq_along(other_pubs)) {
  render_pub_entry(other_pubs[[i]], i)
}
```
